description: Puts an earlier cadence template back ("volta pro template que tava antes"). Without versionId it restores the most recent earlier version; versionId picks another. Steps already sent stay; people who have not received a step get the restored template, but their messages are not rewritten by this call: the result's messagesOutdated counts them and messagesNext describes the rewrite still pending. The restore itself is kept as a version, so it can be undone. applyTo pending (the default) applies it to everyone on the current numbered version, each from where they are; new_only lets who already started finish the current version as it was and makes the restore version N+1. Nothing is sent.

applyTo.description: pending (default): everyone on the current numbered version gets it from where they are. new_only: who already started finishes the current version as it was; the restore is a new numbered version.

versionId.description: Optional version id from the campaign's cadence versions; omitted, the most recent earlier version.

name: restore_cadence_version
title: Restaurar versão da cadência
